parameters.name: DomainNames
parameters.description: The accelerated domain names whose configurations you want to delete. Separate multiple accelerated domain names with commas (,).

parameters.name: FunctionNames
parameters.description: The names of the features that you want to delete. Separate multiple feature names with commas (,). For more information about feature names, see [Parameters for configuring features for domain names](~~388460~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn batch-delete-cdn-domain-config --domain-names example.com,example.org --function-names referer_white_list_set,https_force --region cn-hangzhou
